name: tradeflow-monorepo
description: TradeFlow — Intelligent Logistics & Freight Matching Platform for Landlocked Ethiopia

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "API,WEB" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgCyan.bold" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -k -n "API,WEB,MOBILE" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build:api: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --workspace=@tradeflow/shared && npm run build --workspace=@tradeflow/api

author: TradeFlow Team
